notes: The ASV reorders the object list to the end of the clause, so the waw opening וְגֶשֶׁם שׁוֹטֵף takes the 'and' standing at that clause's English left edge; rule 25 permits the discontinuity, and the seven waws answer seven written 'and's exactly, which rules out leaving one added and one unrepresented.
'great' is added, since אַבְנֵי אֶלְגָּבִישׁ fuses to the single word 'hailstones' and no adjective morpheme stands in the phrase; the unit's note records the competing head reading on אֶלְגָּבִישׁ.
נִשְׁפַּטְתִּי heads on 'judgment' under rule 44's light-verb clause, not on 'enter'.
